audit.whatIsWrong: The lane is rated 8/10 in Camille's favour at three separate stages including '2+ items', but the Emerald+ number is 46.86% over 303 games — Camille loses this lane. Every prose field in the matchup agrees she loses it late ('he out-sustains you outright', 'this is where he reclaims the lane and the win rate'), so the chart contradicts its own text.
audit.why: The early stages are genuinely hers and the prose supports that. The disagreement is entirely at the tail: an 8/10 Camille rating on '2+ items' next to prose saying a drain tank with HP items out-lasts her DPS cannot both be true, and the already-audited mirror at audits/top/tahmkench__camille.json states from his side that two-item Tahm Kench is near-unkillable in extended fights.
audit.corrected: phases[6] and win[6] flipped to Tahm Kench with the inverse rating, matching the prose and the mirror. Earlier stages left alone — they are correct.

audit.why: The spike ladder itself is right and specific: Camille's level 2-3 outer-edge W plus Precision Protocol recast, her level-6 arena, then his level-9 Tongue Lash max and his HP items. Naming level 9 rather than a generic 'mid game' is better than most entries in this champion's data.

audit.whatIsWrong: Devour is called 'W' in six places — 'W-devour an ally for the escape', 'W-devour minions between trades', 'he cannot W-devour an ally out'. Tahm Kench's W is Abyssal Dive. Devour is his R. Camille's passive is written as 'Adaptive Defense' and her R without its article.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon: W is Abyssal Dive, a short blink on 21s at rank 1; R is Devour, the eat. The distinction is load-bearing here because the entire level-6 argument is that the arena stops him eating an ally to escape — that is his R, and it means the thing you are denying him is his ultimate, not a 21s basic ability. The mirror also establishes that the three-stack Tongue Lash stun consumes all three An Acquired Taste stacks and Devour needs three stacks, so he cannot stun you and then eat in the same window — the two threats the text stacks on top of each other are mutually exclusive.
audit.corrected: Devour moved to R throughout; Abyssal Dive named where the blink is meant; Adaptive Defenses and The Hextech Ultimatum given their real names.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'While his grey health is still on cooldown' and 'his Q is down' carry no numbers.
audit.why: Thick Skin is a 3s cooldown — it is effectively always available, so writing it as a cooldown to play around is misleading. Tongue Lash is 7s at rank 1 down to 5s. Abyssal Dive at 21s is the only long cooldown in his kit, which is why the full layer already names it as the one to punish.
audit.corrected: Tongue Lash's 7s and Abyssal Dive's 21s written in; the Thick Skin framing changed from a cooldown to the grey-health conversion window it actually is.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that Camille is untargetable through the R dash.
audit.why: The mirror ships this fact from his side — 'Devour deletes her, but she is untargetable through the R dash' — so both pages should say it. It is the reason a Tahm who holds his eat for her leap wastes it.

edits.before: Hextech Ultimatum drops him into an arena he cannot leave, so he cannot W-devour an ally for the escape — your one clean all-in window with your Adaptive Defense shield up and his Q tongue on cooldown.
edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum drops him into an arena he cannot leave, so Devour (R) buys him no exit — and you are untargetable through the dash, so an eat held for your leap is wasted. Open with Adaptive Defenses up.

edits.before: He out-sustains you outright: Thick Skin grey health plus percent-HP from his kit and HP items out-last your DPS, and one Q stun blanks your whole E-engage commitment once he is tanky.
edits.after: He out-sustains you outright: Thick Skin grey health plus HP items out-last your DPS, and one three-stack Tongue Lash stun blanks your whole E-engage commitment once he is tanky.

edits.before: Hextech Ultimatum is your equalizer at 6 — it locks him in so he cannot W-devour an ally out, giving you one reliable isolated all-in before he out-scales.
edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum equalizes at 6 — the arena means Devour (R) buys him no exit, giving you one reliable isolated all-in before he out-scales.

edits.before: It tilts to him by 4-5: Thick Skin grey health and W-devour reset most of what your trades take, so your raw W damage stops sticking and he edges the attrition.
edits.after: It tilts to him by 4-5: Thick Skin converts grey health back and Abyssal Dive resets his spacing, so your raw W damage stops sticking and he edges the attrition.

edits.before: He out-scales the duel outright — HP items plus grey-health and percent-HP sustain out-last your DPS, and one Q stun cancels your whole E-dive, so play for the map, not the 1v1.
edits.after: He out-scales the duel outright — HP items plus Thick Skin grey health out-last your DPS, and a three-stack Tongue Lash cancels your E-dive, so play the map, not the 1v1.

edits.before: Soak your Q and W burst on grey health, then heal it back with Thick Skin and W-devour minions between trades
edits.after: Soak your Q and W burst on grey health, heal it back through Thick Skin, and Devour minions between trades

edits.before: Use R at 6 to lock him in the arena away from his team so he cannot W-devour an ally out, and convert the isolated 1v1 while your shield is up
edits.after: Use R at 6 to lock him in the arena away from his team so Devour buys him no exit, and convert the isolated 1v1 while your shield is up

edits.before: Levels 4-5 tilt toward him because Thick Skin grey health and W-devour let him reset most of what your trades take, so raw outer-edge W damage does not snowball the way it does into Darius or Sett. Six is your one clean window: Hextech Ultimatum locks him in the arena where he cannot W-devour an ally to escape, so all-in when your E is up, your Adaptive Defense shield is charged, and his Q is down. Do not over-extend hoping to solo-kill — his sustain means a botched all-in just hands him a free grey-health counter-trade.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 tilt toward him because Thick Skin converts grey health back and Abyssal Dive's 21s blink resets his spacing, so raw outer-edge W damage does not snowball the way it does into Darius or Sett. Six is your one clean window: The Hextech Ultimatum locks him in an arena where Devour buys him no exit at all, so all-in when your E is up and Tongue Lash's 7s is spent. Do not over-extend hoping to solo-kill — his sustain means a botched all-in just hands him a free grey-health counter-trade.

notes: Systematic slot error: Devour was written as Tahm Kench's W in six places when it is his R, and his actual W (Abyssal Dive) never appeared. That inverted the stakes of the whole level-6 argument — the arena denies him an ultimate, not a 21s blink. The mirror at audits/top/tahmkench__camille.json also establishes that a three-stack Tongue Lash stun consumes the stacks Devour needs, so he cannot stun and eat in the same window; I stopped short of writing that into Camille's page because it is his sequencing constraint, not hers, but it is why the 'stun cancels your dash AND he eats an ally out' pairing overstates the threat. Chart: '2+ items' was rated 8/10 Camille on a 46.86% lane whose own prose says he reclaims it — flipped to Tahm Kench, which matches the mirror.
